breakpoints.note: After reading a property's value bytes, `_parse_prop_value()` turns the accumulated input into `buf_cstring(&state->buf)` and hands that exact string to `vcardvalue_new_from_string()`. This is the first project statement that creates the vulnerability-relevant time-like string from attacker input.

The fix adds `strlen(str) > 8 &&` before this condition. In the vulnerable code, reaching the `ndig == 2` and `str[2] == ':'` branch is enough to evaluate `str[8]` even when the attacker-controlled string is shorter than nine initialized bytes.

MSan reports the crash at `sscanf_time` line 456:21 on the `str[8]` read. This is the concrete out-of-bounds/poisoned byte consumption that the missing length guard permits.
